sampleGymExercises.name: Chest Press Machine
sampleGymExercises.setup: Adjust seat height so handles align with mid-chest level. Feet flat on the floor.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Smooth controlled forward press with exhalation; controlled return without weights slamming.
safetyPoints: Maintain back and head firmly against backrest.
Do not hyperextend or snap elbows at full extension.
commonMistakes: Shoulders rounding forward toward ears during press.

sampleGymExercises.name: Pec Deck / Fly Machine
sampleGymExercises.setup: Adjust seat so elbows and forearms rest comfortably at mid-chest level.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Horizontal adduction of arms bringing pads/handles together with controlled squeeze.
safetyPoints: Do not force excessive hyperextension of shoulders in the stretched position.
commonMistakes: Pulling with hands and forearms instead of initiating with chest contraction.

sampleGymExercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
sampleGymExercises.setup: Feet firmly planted, scapulae retracted and depressed, grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Controlled descent to lower sternum and press along an arched trajectory.
safetyPoints: Always use bar collar clamps and a qualified spotter for heavy attempts.
commonMistakes: Flaring elbows to 90 degrees risking subacromial impingement.

sampleGymExercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
sampleGymExercises.setup: Incline bench set between 30° and 45°. Kick dumbbells into position using knees.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Press upward with natural convergence at the top without clanking dumbbells together.
safetyPoints: Avoid steep angles (>45°) which shift recruitment predominantly to anterior deltoids.
commonMistakes: Unstable or collapsing wrists during descent.

sampleGymExercises.name: Cable Crossover (Cable Fly)
sampleGymExercises.setup: Set pulleys at desired height, take one step forward to create initial cable tension.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Hug-like sweeping motion with slight elbow bend and peak isometric squeeze.
safetyPoints: Keep torso rigid without rocking or using momentum.
commonMistakes: Turning the fly into a pressing motion.

sampleGymExercises.name: Push-Up (Floor Press)
sampleGymExercises.setup: Hands on the floor shoulder-width apart, body forming a straight line from head to heels.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Lower chest with elbows at 45° until lightly grazing floor, then push back up with full protraction.
safetyPoints: Engage glutes and core to prevent lumbar hyperextension.

sampleGymExercises.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
sampleGymExercises.setup: Thighs locked snugly under pads, overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Pull bar down toward upper sternum while maintaining slight torso lean and depressing shoulders.
safetyPoints: Never pull the bar behind the neck.
commonMistakes: Excessive backward swinging to gain momentum.

sampleGymExercises.name: Seated Cable Row
sampleGymExercises.setup: Feet set against footplates, slight bend in knees, upright spine.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Pull handle into navel while retracting and depressing scapulae at full contraction.
safetyPoints: Avoid rounding the lumbar spine in the stretched position.
commonMistakes: Pulling exclusively with arms without scapular retraction.

sampleGymExercises.name: 45° Leg Press
sampleGymExercises.setup: Back and hips flush against backrest, feet shoulder-width on footplate.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Disengage safety handles, lower carriage until knees reach ~90°, press through whole foot.
safetyPoints: Never allow sacrum to curl off seat at bottom.
Do not snap knees into hyper-lockout at top.

sampleGymExercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
sampleGymExercises.setup: Bar resting securely across upper trapezius, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly flared.
sampleGymExercises.execution: Controlled descent breaking at hips and knees simultaneously down to parallel depth.
safetyPoints: Always squat inside a power rack with safety bars adjusted to appropriate depth.

caseStudies.title: Case 1: Advanced Strength Athlete
caseStudies.subtitle: Overcoming plateau on deadlift and back squat
caseStudies.overview: Advanced programming for an athlete with 8 years of training history facing stagnation.
caseStudies.rationale: Conjugate system adoption with weekly max effort rotations and weak-point focus.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: +12.5 kg on 1RM in 16 weeks with reduced tendon fatigue.

caseStudies.title: Case 2: Hypertrophy Plateau
caseStudies.subtitle: Managing Maximum Recoverable Volume (MRV)
caseStudies.overview: Natural bodybuilder with volume plateau on lagging muscle groups (lats and lateral deltoids).
caseStudies.rationale: Specialization mesocycle with 3x weekly frequency and maintenance volume for other groups.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: +1.8 cm shoulder-chest circumference and muscle resensitization.

caseStudies.title: Case 3: Explosive Power Development (RFD)
caseStudies.subtitle: Converting maximal strength to velocity in team sport
caseStudies.overview: Strength and conditioning protocol for a professional basketball player.
caseStudies.rationale: Reactive plyometrics combined with contrast training at 80% 1RM and medicine ball throws.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: +7.2 cm in countermovement jump (CMJ) in 12 weeks.

caseStudies.title: Case 4: Fatigue Management & Overtraining Prevention
caseStudies.subtitle: Restoring autonomic balance in an over-stressed athlete
caseStudies.overview: Athlete with chronic performance drop and sleep disruptions due to cumulative overload.
caseStudies.rationale: Progressive active deload protocol, HRV monitoring and density reduction.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: Restoration of baseline HRV in 3 weeks and full return to athletic efficiency.

caseStudies.title: Case 5: Long-Term Program Review
caseStudies.subtitle: Adapting an annual plan following unplanned interruptions
caseStudies.overview: Macrocycle restructuring 4 months prior to target competition.
caseStudies.rationale: Reorganization of block timelines while preserving primary neuromuscular qualities.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: Peak performance achieved exactly on competition target date.

caseStudies.title: Case 6: Complex Client Communication
caseStudies.subtitle: Resolving conflict and managing unrealistic expectations
caseStudies.overview: Executive client with severe schedule constraints and non-physiological progress goals.
caseStudies.rationale: SMART goal recalibration, motivational interviewing and consistency incentives.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: Adherence increased from 50% to 92% with annual package renewal.

caseStudies.title: Case 7: Head Coach Supervision

caseStudies.overview: Elevating service quality standards across a high-profile health club.
caseStudies.rationale: Implementation of SOP checklists, peer-review sessions and monthly biomechanics workshops.
caseStudies.keyOutcomes: Zero client complaints and a 24% increase in member retention.
